answer: Each identity must string one thread along a distinct rung of the trellis, melting its tundra frost: the k-th thread re-melts the two frost patterns below it, so cost follows Fibonacci, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5 hours; N fakes cost 143 for 10 and over 927 quintillion for 100. Two threads on one rung freeze together and snap at the close, so clones cannot share a rung to split the melt.
